questions.prompt: What is the effect of Northern Hemisphere aerosol cooling on the Intertropical Convergence Zone (ITCZ)?
questions.answer: Cooling concentrated in the Northern Hemisphere causes the ITCZ to shift southward toward the relatively warmer hemisphere.

questions.prompt: What is the change in the interhemispheric temperature difference that is attributed to anthropogenic aerosol during the twentieth century?
questions.answer: Anthropogenic aerosol contributed to an interhemispheric temperature difference of roughly 0.1 K.

questions.prompt: During the mid-1980s Sahel drought, rainfall fell to approximately what fraction of its climatological mean?
questions.answer: Sahel rainfall during the major drought period fell to roughly 60% of its long-term mean.

questions.prompt: Northern Hemisphere aerosol emissions are generally associated with what effect on Northern Hemisphere monsoons?
questions.answer: Northern Hemisphere aerosol cooling weakens monsoon circulations and reduces monsoon rainfall.

questions.prompt: Model studies indicate that anthropogenic aerosol contributed approximately what reduction in Northern Hemisphere monsoon precipitation between 1951 and 2005?
questions.answer: Simulations suggest aerosol forcing reduced Northern Hemisphere monsoon precipitation by about 5–11%.

questions.prompt: An observed drying trend over South Asia from 1950 to 2002 has been attributed largely to anthropogenic aerosol. What is the approximate magnitude of this drying trend?
questions.answer: The South Asian monsoon exhibited a drying trend of approximately 0.18 mm day⁻¹ decade⁻¹.

questions.prompt: Aerosol forcing is considered important for understanding variability in which of the following climate phenomena? Select all that apply.
questions.answer: Aerosol forcing has been implicated in all of these components of climate variabilty. See section 13.4.

questions.prompt: Aerosol cooling in the Pacific is associated with which one of the following changes in Pacific climate variability?
questions.answer: Aerosol-induced cooling can strengthen trade winds and alter Pacific climate variability.

questions.prompt: Which statement best describes aerosol-driven climate responses?
questions.answer: Aerosol forcing is spatially heterogeneous and can influence distant regions through atmospheric teleconnections.
options: The effects are mostly local and do not influence distant regions
They are patchy and can produce remote teleconnections
They only affect locations directly above emissions
They operate only through changes in clouds and precipitation

questions.prompt: What is the value of π (pi)?
questions.answerInfo: Pi is the ratio of a circle's circumference to its diameter, so it is dimensionless.

questions.prompt: Is this chart about radiative forcings or climate feedbacks?
questions.answer: It's forcings, shown on the x-axis

parts.prompt: Write one short sentence explaining what makes a question multi-part.
parts.label: (a)
parts.answer: A multi-part question has two or more subquestions that are answered separately.

questions.prompt: What is the standard acceleration due to gravity at Earth's surface?
questions.answerInfo: This is the conventional standard gravity.

questions.prompt: Which of the following are greenhouse gases?
questions.answer: The greenhouse gases are carbon dioxide, methane, and water vapor. Oxygen is not a greenhouse gas.
